svg.title: Recipeat backend infrastructure and request flows
svg.text: Four containers, and every request path through them, as deployed today. Ports are host-side. Dashed grey is planned, not written.
The five app routes are the whole public surface. Four of them need the session cookie, and only the OIDC login flow can mint one.
The three services underneath are unauthenticated and published on loopback only — an SSH tunnel is the sole way in from outside.
runtimeConfig: ollamaBaseUrl · ollamaModel · ocrBaseUrl · fetcherBaseUrl env: NUXT_OIDC_*

The website path never reaches the model. recipe-scrapers
and ingredient-parser read the page deterministically,
which is why it costs seconds where the others cost minutes.
Nothing is stored. An extraction can be previewed before it
is kept, and a photo is never written to disk.
Every failure is fail(status, message, cause). The cause —
upstream bodies, host names, stack traces — is logged by
Nitro and never serialized to the client.
Measured containerized on a developer machine: a pasted
recipe 1m 29s, the same page as a photo 1m 36s, of which
OCR is 3.5s. The model is very nearly the whole cost.
